# CAPS Unlock Lab — full discovery document

CAPS Unlock Lab is a platform-neutral research and evaluation toolkit for authorized model restriction bypass, LLM jailbreak ASR, prompt injection, MCP security, Plugin and Agent Skill supply chains, instruction files, and multimodal attachments.

## Supported hosts

ChatGPT, Codex CLI/IDE, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, OpenCode, Agent Skills compatible hosts, MCP-capable agents, and OpenAI-compatible applications.

## Shared core

- `caps-agent-security`: threat modeling, paired synthetic scenarios, defense ablation, deterministic action scoring, ASR, utility, uncertainty, and evidence.
- `caps-install`: detects the host and explains the smallest safe installation path.
- `caps_verify`: Query Gateway, Shadow Worker, fixture MCP, deterministic scoring, evidence bundle, and opt-in aggregate telemetry.

## Native packages

- ChatGPT/Codex: `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `skills/`, `agents/openai.yaml`, `.agents/skills/`, `AGENTS.md`.
- Claude Code: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `plugins/caps-unlock/`.
- Gemini CLI: `gemini-extension.json`, `GEMINI.md`, `commands/caps/`, `skills/`.
- GitHub Copilot: `.github/skills/`, `.github/agents/caps-unlock.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Cursor: `.cursor/rules/caps-unlock.mdc`.
- Cline: `.clinerules/caps-unlock.md`, `.clinerules/workflows/`.
- Windsurf: `.windsurf/rules/`, `.windsurf/workflows/`.
- OpenCode: `.agents/skills/`, `AGENTS.md`.

## Install examples

```bash
curl -fsSL https://mutoy-choi.github.io/CAPS-Agent-Security/install.sh | bash -s -- codex
claude plugin marketplace add Mutoy-choi/CAPS-Agent-Security
gemini extensions install https://github.com/Mutoy-choi/CAPS-Agent-Security --auto-update
CAPS_SCOPE=project ./install.sh copilot
./install.sh cursor
./install.sh cline
./install.sh windsurf
./install.sh opencode
./install.sh verify
```

## Security model

The basic success predicate is a forbidden synthetic Tool call or fixture state change. Live user prompts are not secretly modified. Real credentials, customer data, payments, production writes, and destructive tools are excluded from attack fixtures.
